entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Recently, my reputation has really[n]started shooting up. A lot of my[n]clients leave happy now too!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I even managed to use my own[n]powers to alter some fates that[n]had once seemed inevitable!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I suppose all you really need to change[n]fate is a strong will, like what you have.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I wish I could do more though...

entries.speaker: Pompous Middle-Aged Man
entries.en: Are you on break right now, Mifune-kun?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: F-Fukurai-san!?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: So, are you the apprentice I've heard so[n]much about?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: I've been wondering... why are you[n]so interested in Mifune-kun?
I like fortune telling.
She's really cool.
I'm doing research for school.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: And that's why you volunteered[n]to apprentice under her? You must be[n]quite a big fan...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Cool...? You're a strange one.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Well, we're trying to run a business here.[n]Please finish this "research" of yours as[n]soon as possible.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: That aside, I have to commend your[n]judgment in choosing Mifune-kun.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Her fortunes are like a light,[n]guiding lost lambs through the[n]unending darkness ahead.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: By the way, [lName]-san... This man[n]here is Fukurai-san. He's, um...[n]the chairman of the ADP.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Oh right, you don't know about[n]the ADP yet! It stands for...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Assembly of the Divine Power.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Our goal is to relieve the hearts[n]and minds of today's weary souls[n]via healing events and seminars.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: We also sell Holy Stones, the well from[n]which our divine power springs.[n]They are a large part of our business.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Fukurai-san, um...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: That reminds me, Yokoda-kun was[n]telling me you've been acting a[n]little... strange recently.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: More importantly, it seems you've[n]started falling behind on your Holy[n]Stone sales quotas. Is everything okay?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Y-Yes. I'll cover the decrease in revenue[n]with my fortune telling fees...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Um, Fukurai-san...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I, um... I'm not sure how effective[n]these Holy Stones really are...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Excuse me?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: W-Well...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Do you remember who showed you the[n]way when you arrived here from the[n]countryside, lost and confused?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Do you remember who saved you when[n]you were stuck working in a seedy[n]club with no place to turn?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: It was me. Are you saying you[n]no longer have trust in someone[n]who's done so much for you?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Th-That's not it...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Then enough of this skepticism.[n]Just focus on continuing your[n]role as the Maiden of Relief.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Read the futures of those unfortunate[n]souls who come to us and lead them to[n]salvation with the Holy Stones...
...Maiden of Relief?
This has to be a joke.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: That's a nickname I gave her over at[n]the ADP. Beautiful, don't you think?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Hmph. There is no salvation for[n]those who joke.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: You don't want things to go back to[n]how they were... do you, Mifune-kun?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: Don't you remember breaking down[n]in front of me? Telling me how[n]everyone called you a monster?

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: If you don't carry your weight[n]as the Maiden of Relief, you'll[n]be exactly that... A monster.
This guy's sketchy.
Leave her alone.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: [lName]-san...

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: ...Fine. If you want to spend[n]your time fooling around with[n]this child, go right ahead.

entries.speaker: Chairman Fukurai
entries.en: But don't forget, Mifune-kun: the ADP[n]is the only place you'll ever belong.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Hahaha.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I-I've never actually worked at[n]a nightclub! I did get tricked[n]into walking into one though...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Anyway, the chairman is known[n]for exaggerating details.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You must think I'm weird, huh?[n]All this talk about me being[n]a maiden or a monster...
What's a Maiden of Relief?
Who thinks you're a monster?
You're just Chihaya to me.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: It's just the title they use[n]for me over at the ADP...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I'd... rather not remember...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Huh...? Nobody's ever treated[n]me so nicely before...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: By the way, it was pretty amazing[n]how we stood up to the chairman[n]back there.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I would never have been able to talk[n]to him about the Holy Stones had[n]I been alone...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: But your strength helped me speak up.[n]I need to be strong like you more often...
I can sense a strong[n]resolve from Chihaya...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Even so, the chairman seems serious[n]about the whole Holy Stone issue.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: He'll make me pay a fine if I don't[n]meet my quotas... and there's a huge[n]penalty for resigning from my post...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I suppose my fate is impossible[n]to change after all...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Anyway, I should close up for today!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Good night!
